categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three core business segments: green energy solutions, residential energy storage and photovoltaic grid-connected inverters, and high-voltage variable frequency drives (VFDs) for industrial automation. The green energy solutions include residential and commercial photovoltaic EPC projects and villa green electricity solutions. The industrial automation segment focuses on high-voltage VFDs used in power, metallurgy, coal mining, petrochemical, and building materials industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D and vertical integration in hardware and software, including power electronics, battery management systems (BMS), energy management systems (EMS), and inverter technologies. It employs modular design for energy storage products, AI-driven smart strategies, and advanced control platforms for high-voltage VFDs. Manufacturing includes advanced automated production lines and digital workshops, with in-house production of key components and software systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include residential homeowners, commercial and industrial enterprises, and utility-scale energy projects. The company serves the renewable energy sector, particularly photovoltaic and energy storage markets, as well as industrial sectors requiring automation solutions. Major customers include financial leasing companies and industrial clients in China, with growing overseas market presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with over 94% of revenue generated domestically. It has expanding international sales, particularly in Europe, Australia, Asia, and Africa, targeting emerging markets for residential energy storage and photovoltaic products. Subsidiaries and manufacturing bases are located in Beijing, Hefei, Anqing, and Wuhan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly midstream and downstream in the renewable energy and industrial automation supply chains. It provides integrated EPC services, designs and manufactures core components like inverters and energy storage systems, and offers after-sales operation and maintenance services. It maintains control over key R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain functions, reducing reliance on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on the three core business segments, enhancing product competitiveness through high R&D investment, and expanding global market penetration. R&D efforts target next-generation power semiconductor technologies, large-capacity lithium batteries, AI integration, and smart EMS platforms. The company also emphasizes digital transformation in manufacturing and marketing, and continuous product innovation to meet diverse customer needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of photovoltaic EPC projects, energy storage systems, inverters, and high-voltage VFDs. The company also earns income from long-term operation and maintenance services, project financing cooperation, and after-sales services. Sales channels include direct sales and distributor networks, with a growing emphasis on digital platforms and overseas ODM/OBM sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in high-voltage VFDs and a competitive innovator in the renewable energy sector, particularly in photovoltaic EPC and residential energy storage. It benefits from the backing and brand authorization of Midea Group, enhancing its market credibility. The residential energy storage market is fragmented globally, with the company actively expanding internationally to compete with global and local players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 4.78 billion, a 220% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 10.3 million. The company’s assets totaled around RMB 4.63 billion, growing 46% from the previous year. R&D expenses more than doubled to RMB 320 million, reflecting a strong growth and investment trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company leverages Midea Group’s brand and resources to offer trusted, integrated green energy solutions with strong digital and operational capabilities. Its vertically integrated R&D and manufacturing enable high-quality, customizable products with advanced safety and efficiency features. Differentiation is also achieved through modular, AI-driven energy storage systems, comprehensive lifecycle management services for VFDs, and smart energy management platforms tailored to diverse customer segments.
